title: 第二十一章 旧义庄听哭
novel_title: 坟头开铺，我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
content_zh:
旧义庄在城北山脚下。

    从梁家出来，天还没亮透，山道上的雾压在脸上，又湿又重。燕不归走在最前，腰间窄刀一晃一晃，没说多余的话。

    沈清萝跟在后头，手里还捏着那张城北阴宅图。

    梁家祖坟，旧义庄，乱葬沟。

    三个地方被朱砂圈起来，像三只没闭上的眼。

    阿青从引魂铃里探出半张脸，声音还有点哑：“不直接去乱葬沟吗？小煞灵不是说沟里好多小孩？”

    燕不归头也不回：“死人进乱葬沟之前，先过义庄。”

    沈清萝把图折起来。

    “停尸簿。”

    燕不归看她一眼。

    沈清萝道：“乱葬沟没有墓碑，没买地券，也没香火。那就只能查他们被送进去前的最后一道门。”

    燕不归没再说话。

    谢无咎走在她身侧，脸色不太好。

    倒不是受伤。

    是他看不惯沈清萝走路。

    山路湿，石阶滑。沈清萝一边走，一边低头看图，鞋尖两次差点踩进泥坑里。

    第三次脚下一滑，谢无咎终于伸手，扣住她后领，把人往回一拽。

    沈清萝被他拽得踉跄半步，回头就瞪他。

    “你拎猫呢？”

    谢无咎没理她，只把一件黑色斗篷丢到她肩上。

    “披上。”

    “防滑？”

    “防你身上的活人气把沟里的东西全招过来。”

    沈清萝低头看了眼斗篷。太大，拖地，像他从哪扯下来的门帘。

    “那你刚才拽我后领，也是避煞？”

    “不然看你滚下去？”

    糖糕跳上路边石头，看了看那件斗篷，尾巴一甩：“拎猫的手法倒是挺熟。”

    斗篷宽大得离谱，黑沉沉压住她半身，边角拖在地上。沈清萝走一步，踩一下。走两步，又踩一下。

    她忍了片刻，回头：“谢无咎，你故意的？”

    谢无咎淡淡道：“你可以不穿。”

    他话音刚落，山道旁一团游魂飘近。那魂影原本冲着沈清萝肩头的阳气来，刚靠近半尺，就被斗篷上的冷煞气逼得缩了回去。

    沈清萝看着那团游魂，又看了看拖地的斗篷。

    行。

    有用。

    但有用也不影响它像门帘。

    她低头走了几步，实在烦了，干脆抽出桃木剑，嗤啦一下割掉拖地那截。

    宋砚的眼皮跳了一下。

    谢无咎停住脚。

    沈清萝把割下来的布料塞回他手里。

    “你给的，你拿着。”

    谢无咎看着手里的黑布。

    “你敢撕幽冥渊的织物？”

    沈清萝很平静：“你敢拿幽冥渊的织物当门帘给我穿？”

    阿青在铃里低低笑了一声。

    燕不归走到义庄门前，终于回头：“二位，义庄到了。要吵进去吵，外面冷。”
content_en:
Jiuzhuang is at the foot of the mountain in the north of the city.

    When we came out of Liang's house, it was still dark, and the fog on the mountain road pressed on our face, making it wet and heavy. Yan Bugui walked in the front, flashing the narrow knife at his waist without saying any unnecessary words.

    Shen Qingluo followed behind, still holding the picture of the Yin House in the north of the city in her hand.

    The ancestral graves of the Liang family, the old Yizhuang, and the mass graves.

    Three places are surrounded by cinnabar, like three unclosed eyes.

    Ah Qing poked half of his face out of the soul-inducing bell, and his voice was a little hoarse: "Why don't you just go to the mass grave ditch? Didn't the little evil spirit say there are many children in the ditch?"

    Yan Bugui didn't look back: "Before the dead go into the mass grave, they must first pass through Yizhuang."

    Shen Qingluo folded the picture.

    "Morgue Book."

    Yan Bugui glanced at her.

    Shen Qingluo said: "There are no tombstones in the mass graves, no land coupons, and no incense. Then we can only check the last door before they were sent in."

    Yan Bugui said no more.

    Xie Wujiu walked beside her, his expression not very good.

    Not that he was injured.

    It was because he couldn't stand Shen Qingluo walking.

    The mountain road is wet and the stone steps are slippery. As Shen Qingluo walked, she lowered her head to look at the pictures, and almost stepped into the mud twice with the tip of her shoes.

    The third time his foot slipped, Xie Wujiu finally stretched out his hand, grabbed her collar and pulled her back.

    Shen Qingluo staggered half a step as he pulled her back, then turned to glare at him.

    "Where are you carrying the cat?"

    Xie Wujiu ignored her and just threw a black cloak onto her shoulders.

    "Put it on."

    "Anti-slip?"

    "Just in case your vitality attracts all the things in the ditch."

    Shen Qingluo looked down at the cloak. It was so big that it dragged the floor, like a door curtain he had torn off somewhere.

    "Then you just pulled me by the collar to avoid evil?"

    "How about you get out of there?"

    Tanggai jumped onto the stone on the side of the road, looked at the cloak, and flicked her tail: "I'm quite familiar with how to carry a cat."

    The cloak was ridiculously wide and dark, covering half of her body, and the corners trailed to the ground. Shen Qingluo took a step and stepped on it. Take two steps, then step again.

    She endured it for a moment and then turned around: "Xie Wujiu, did you do this on purpose?"

    Xie Wu Jiu said calmly: "You don't have to wear it."

    As soon as he finished speaking, a group of wandering souls floated near the mountain road. The soul shadow originally came towards the Yang Qi on Shen Qingluo's shoulder, but when it got close to half a foot, it was forced back by the cold evil Qi on the cloak.

    Shen Qingluo looked at the group of wandering souls, and then at the cloak that was mopping the floor.

    OK.

    it works.

    But its usefulness does not prevent it from being like a door curtain.

    She lowered her head and walked for a few steps. When she got really fed up, she simply pulled out her mahogany sword and cut off the part that was mopping the floor.

    Song Yan's eyelids twitched.

    Xie Wujiu stopped.

    Shen Qingluo stuffed the cut cloth back into his hand.

    "You give it, you take it."

    Xie Wujiu looked at the black cloth in his hand.

    "You dare to tear the fabric of Netherworld Abyss?"

    Shen Qingluo was very calm: "How dare you use Netherworld's fabric as a curtain for me to wear?"

    Ah Qing laughed softly in the bell.

    Yan Bugui walked to the door of Yizhuang and finally turned around: "You two, Yizhuang is here. If you want to make a noise, go in and make a noise. It's cold outside."
